author: Charles Dunlap
title: Columbia man dies in I-70 crash; small apartment fire quickly put out - NewsBreak
text:
By Charles Dunlap ,
1 days ago A Columbia man has died following a June 27 crash on eastbound Interstate 70.
Elbert Allen, 69, crashed into a guardrail near the near the 123.2 mile marker, the Columbia Police Department reported. He was taken to a local hospital in critical condition and later died from his injuries. Next of kin was notified.
Columbia Fire Department responds to apartment fire The Columbia Fire Department arrived within three minutes of a 7:32 a.m. call Monday, June 29, for an apartment fire in the 1600 Block of Hinkson Avenue.
Smoke was showing from the second floor of the three-floor complex when firefighters arrived. As residents evacuated, fire department personnel found a small fire on a balcony in the rear of the building and immediately initiated the fire attack, the department said.
Damage was limited and the fire was contained to the to the area of origin and was safely under control within another three minutes from firefighter arrival. All building occupants had safely evacuated and there were no reported injuries.
The Columbia Fire Marshal Batalion determined the cause and origin of the fire was improperly discarded smoking materials on the deck area.
This article originally appeared on Columbia Daily Tribune: Columbia man dies in I-70 crash; small apartment fire quickly put out
